case_number: 2025 INSC 346; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 @ SLP (CRL) NO.1104 OF 2022
summary: Moratorium under IBC s.14 does not bar proceedings against director under NI Act s.138; cause of action under s.138 arises only upon failure to pay within 15 days of demand notice; notice issued on 06.08.2018, cause of action arose post-moratorium (25.07.2018); distinction from P. Mohan Raj noted; ingredients of s.138 offence reaffirmed; proceedings against director not barred; petition under s.482 CrPC dismissed by High Court upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order upholding proceedings under s.138 of NI Act upheld; no quashing of proceedings against the appellant-director.
